Name: Arti's Pixel Portriaits
Author: 4rt1ficer
Description:
Hello, this is my first ever mod, made for Stardew Modfest! I'd been planning on making this mod for a while and the modfest was the perfect excuse!

At present this portrait mod changes Maru, Harvey, and Sam, and has some mild customization options for both Maru and Sam. Elliott and Penny are both in the works, and I do intend to eventually get every single character in the game done, so keep an eye out!

Requires Smapi, Content Patcher and JP's Shin HD Portraits Framework, and it's highly recommended you also install Generic Mod Config Menu.

Downloads.Description: Portraits for Maru, Sam, and Harvey.
